# How to get VC

VC is the gas token of VinuChain (chain 207). This page lists the routes that work today, in the order that puts VC on VinuChain most directly. It is information, not advice, and it does not recommend buying anything.

**Risk warning.** Crypto assets are highly volatile and you can lose all the money you put in. Only use money you can afford to lose. This page is not financial advice.

**Where you live matters.** Some venues do not serve some countries, and some require identity checks. Check the terms of each venue before you start.

## Route 1: Gate, withdrawing straight to VinuChain

This is the shortest working route. VC lands directly on VinuChain.

1. Add VinuChain to your wallet, so you have a chain-207 address ready.
2. Open a Gate account. Gate decides which regions it serves and which identity checks apply.
3. Buy VC on the VC/USDT market: open the VC/USDT market on Gate.
4. Withdraw VC and choose the network named VC. Do not choose BSC.
5. Paste your VinuChain address (a 0x address on chain 207).

**Check the network name on both sides.** Choosing BSC gives you BEP-20 VC on BNB Smart Chain. That is a different form of the token. It does not pay for gas on VinuChain and needs a bridge step to convert.

Sizes above about $300 belong on Gate. Other order books are thin, and a larger order moves the cost sharply.
